# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large batch of real call-center audio transcripts for **Crayon Roofing & Structures**, a Manali (Chennai, near Andarkuppam/CPCL) based **JSW metal-roofing-sheet distributor/dealer**. The majority of calls are short, transactional, and in Tamil with English technical terms mixed in. Only a genuine subset qualifies as "sales" calls — price/rate enquiries, stock checks, quotation follow-ups, order confirmations, and dealer price-matching negotiations. A large share of the remaining audio is **internal ops noise** (loading/crane/driver coordination, bill-copy handovers, Rapido/vehicle-booking app disputes, gift-distribution logistics, personal/HR chatter) which has been excluded here per instructions.

Within the real sales calls, the business is clearly a **supply-only (no fabrication/fixing) distributor** of JSW roofing products and allied hardware — confirmed explicitly in one call: *"Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது. Supply மட்டும் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம் sir."* [We don't do fixing/installation, only supply.] Given the fragmented, repetitive nature of the data (many duplicate calls, many one-line stock checks), this KB should be read as a **directional, not exhaustive**, guide — rates and policies below are only those that literally appear in the transcripts.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon sells several **JSW-family metal roofing sheet brands** at different price/quality tiers, plus allied accessories and consumables:

- **JSW Color On Plus** — the premium line. Comes in multiple colors: sky blue, off white, grey, blue, red, brick red, CH/cauliflower green ("California Green"). Available thicknesses 0.40/0.45/0.47/0.50/0.60 mm with AZ70 or AZ150 (aluminum-zinc) coating grades, 15-year warranty mentioned for both thickness tiers (warranty does **not** change with thickness, only price/thickness do).
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — a cheaper JSW sub-brand. Stock colors are normally limited to **sky blue and off white only** ("Pragathi-ல sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்"). Grey/brick red/green are *not* regularly stocked in Pragathi — must be specially sourced for bulk (≥10 ton) orders.
- **Indira Dhanush (Indradhanush)** — another JSW variant, cited at 0.45 mm (sky blue/half white only) and used as a lower-thickness/lower-price alternative (0.35–0.47 range referenced).
- **Radiance / Silver On / Silver On Plus** — further branded lines, color-coated and bare galvanized (AZ150) variants; used interchangeably in rate-comparison conversations with competitors.
- **PUFF (polyurethane foam) roof panels** — 50 mm, insulated panels with top & bottom metal skin thickness specified separately.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — sold in various thicknesses (0.8 mm, 2 mm) and widths ("full width" ~4 ft standard); used for skylights/commercial sites.
- **Decking sheets** — 0.8 mm, 1 mm, 1.2 mm profile decking, used for structural flooring/transformer platforms.
- **Accessories**: L-flashing, ridge/flashing sold by running meter (standard length 2.5 m), ventilators, self-cleaning screws.
- **Hardware consumables**: **Tata brand self-tapping/self-drilling screws** (DT = double thread, FT = full thread, various sizes 1", 1.5", 2", 2.5", 3.15", stitch screws), **Tata welding electrodes/rods**, **CO2 MIG welding wire coils (1.2 mm)**, cutting & grinding wheels (4 inch).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

> Rates fluctuate call-to-call (market/notice-driven) — treat these as *examples of how pricing is quoted*, not a fixed price list.

- JSW Color On Plus 0.47 mm, AZ150 — **₹435 + GST / sq.m**; also quoted **₹430 + GST**, **₹445 + GST**, and **₹465–475 + GST** in different calls.
- JSW Color On Plus 0.50 mm, AZ150 — **₹475 + GST / sq.m** (15-year warranty line).
- Indira Dhanush 0.45 mm, AZ70 — **₹375 + GST / sq.m**.
- Pragathi Plus 0.47 mm, AZ70 — **₹405 + GST / sq.m**; kg-basis quoted around **₹101–107 + GST / kg**.
- Pragathi Plus 0.40 mm — **₹105 + GST**.
- Radiance 0.6 mm sky blue, AZ150 — **₹560 + GST / sq.m**.
- Plain/bare 0.40 mm sheet, 4 ft width — **₹100–101 + GST / kg**; explicit distinction: *"₹100-ன்னது cash and carry price... credit-க்கு ₹1 extra"* [₹100 is cash-and-carry; credit customers pay ₹1 more/kg].
- 70 GSM color coating — **₹405 + GST**; 150 GSM — **₹435 + GST** (per sheet/sq.ft context, roofing shed quote); a **₹5/150 GSM discount** offered if paid "1st to 30th" of the month.
- JSW steel/weight-based deal — **₹107/kg or ₹405/sq.m** quoted interchangeably, with note that square-meter billing is preferred by buyers because factories tend to over-weigh (~200 g extra) when billing by kg.
- Welding electrode (2.5 mm) — **₹332–336 incl. GST** (regular), offer price **₹270 + GST** mentioned once.
- Tata self-tapping screw, 130 mm — **₹14 + GST / piece**.
- PUFF panel, 50 mm — **₹1600 + GST / sq.
